SettingsUserGroup.description: A Team the caller belongs to.

memberCount.description: How many members the Team has, the caller included.

isTeamAdmin.description: Whether the caller is a team admin of this Team: may manage its members, its Projects and its Team collections.

isAdmin.description: Whether the caller is an organization admin. Admin is a role per user, not membership of a Team.

mcpEnabled.description: Whether Connected assistants (MCP) is enabled for this instance. Readable by any signed-in user so Settings can hide the pane without calling Admin APIs.
